31 March 2022

## Circular to Intermediaries

## Publication of End-To-End (E2E) Test packages and File Transfer Connectivity Guide for the Hong Kong Investor Identification Regime (HKIDR)

Reference is made to the Circular  on  18  March  2022  regarding  the  E2E  test  for  systems relating to the HKIDR.

## End-To-End Test

The  Stock  Exchange  of  Hong  Kong  (SEHK)  has  published  the  following  documents  for Relevant  Regulated  Intermediaries 1  (RRIs)  to  download  and  get  ready  for  the  upcoming mandatory E2E Test commencing between mid-May and June 2022 .

1. E2E Test Package for Exchange Participant (EP) (containing the testing guidelines, details  of  two  new  features  of  SEHK's  Orion  Central  Gateway  -  Securities  Market (OCG-C) to be implemented together with the HKIDR and other relevant information);
2. E2E Test Package for non-EP RRI (containing the testing guidelines and other relevant information); and
3. HKIDR  File  Transfer  Connectivity  Guide  (a  technical  reference  guide  for  HKIDR interface files exchange through the SEHK's Electronic Communication Platform (ECP) covering both the ECP Web Interface and the ECP (SFTP) Interface).

The E2E Test package for non-EP RRI and the HKIDR File Transfer Connectivity Guide are available on the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited's (HKEX) HKIDR web corner; while the E2E Test package for EP is available on SEHK's ECP and the download procedure is in the Attachment.

The exact test period of the E2E Test will be further announced in mid-April 2022 . In order to participate  in  the  mandatory  E2E  Test  for  submitting  the  BCAN-CID  Mapping  File  and Reporting Forms to SEHK's data repository, Responsible Officers of  the relevant  licensed corporations and Executive Officers of the relevant registered institutions should apply for a test account via the SFC's WINGS platform. Details will be announced in mid-April 2022 .

To facilitate the E2E Test, SEHK will publish the templates of the five Reporting Forms in midApril 2022 for RRI's reference. For the avoidance of doubt, SEHK will not provide a template for the BCAN-CID Mapping File, and RRIs should refer to Section 2 of SEHK's File Interface Specifications when preparing the BCAN-CID Mapping File.

1  Relevant Regulated Intermediaries refer to SFC-licensed corporations and registered institutions subject to the HKIDR  pursuant  to  the  proposed  paragraph  5.6  of  the  SFC's  Code  of  Conduct  for  Persons  Licensed  by  or Registered with the SFC.

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

## Use of ECP (SFTP) Interface

During the E2E Test, RRIs can submit the BCAN-CID Mapping File and Reporting Forms to SEHK's data repository via ECP web interface and/or ECP (SFTP) interface. Non-EP RRIs who intend to leverage on the ECP (SFTP) interface should install HKEX's Securities and Derivatives Network (SDNet/2) testing line before the start of the E2E Test. For details, please refer to HKEX's Circular regarding publication of E2E test package and file transfer connectivity guide and E2E Test package for non-EP RRI separately.
